subject: english
stem: Which answer is supported by the passage that includes “A group of students cleaned the beach last Friday.”?
options: It had textbooks, notebooks, old test papers, two water bottles, and things he did not remember putting inside.
Lamps, toys, clocks, chairs, and bags are placed on a long wooden table.
When Ruby cleaned her father's desk, she found an old movie ticket.
They found plastic bags, old shoes, broken toys, and more than two hundred bottles.

optionRationales.reason: 本文沒有陳述「It had textbooks, notebooks, old test papers, two water bottles, and things he did not remember putting inside.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「Lamps, toys, clocks, chairs, and bags are placed on a long wooden table.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「When Ruby cleaned her father's desk, she found an old movie ticket.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文可直接核對「They found plastic bags, old shoes, broken toys, and more than two hundred bottles.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。

provenance.copyrightStatus: Original wording; official sources used only for scope and assessment calibration.

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「They found plastic bags, old shoes, broken toys, and more than two hundred bottles.」，答案為「They found plastic bags, old shoes, broken toys, and more than two hundred bottles.」。
獨立覆核 B：逐項回查文章，只有「They found plastic bags, old shoes, broken toys, and more than two hundred bottles.」有同篇證據，三個干擾項均來自不同情境。
